title: Hoyahoya language
description: Anim language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Hoyahoya (Matakia) is an Anim language spoken in the village of Matakaia of Bamu Rural LLG in Western Province, Papua New Guinea. It shares its name with the closely related Hoia Hoia language. It is documented solely in an unpublished wordlist by Carr (1991).
